summary: Full-extraction pass over 15 stored Turkish documents: the seven Gazette amendment decrees (OCR tur+eng) and the consolidated regulation, Law 6735, an opposition bill, two Plan and Budget Committee records, two Land Registry pages and the TurkStat foreign house-sales table. Most rules and headline numbers were already in the data; this pass adds 156 monthly foreign house-sales rows, MPs' claims (about 500,000 naturalised; 310,000 and 67,000 house sales), the minister's 451 irregular naturalisations, two missing pre-sale-contract terms (2022) and six dated rules or events. All 15 complete.

events.title: Investor residence permit category created
events.description: Law 6735 adds to Foreigners Law 6458 Art. 31(1)(j) a short-term residence permit for foreigners who do not work in Turkey but invest in the scope and amount to be set by the Council of Ministers, with spouse and children; these permits may be issued for up to five years at a time (new Art. 31(5)). Holders of this permit (and Turquoise Card holders) are the group made eligible for exceptional naturalisation by the same law.
events.quote: Türkiye’de çalışmayan ancak Bakanlar Kurulunca belirlenecek kapsam ve tutarda yatırım yapacaklar ile bunların yabancı eşi

events.title: President decides; inter-ministerial commission; cross rates allowed
events.description: Presidential Decree 106 makes the President (instead of a Ministry proposal and Council of Ministers decision) the deciding authority for investor naturalisation, allows cross exchange rates as well as the CBRT effective selling rate for valuing amounts (para. 6), and lets a commission of Family/Labour, Environment, Treasury and Industry representatives be set up within the Interior Ministry to follow applications (new para. 7). Switching between investment types to complete the holding period (new para. 8) is in the price-change event of the same day.
events.quote: İçişleri Bakanlığı bünyesinde Aile, Çalışma ve Sosyal Hizmetler Bakanlığı, Çevre ve Şehircilik Bakanlığı, Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı, Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı temsilcilerinden oluşan bir komisyon kurulabilir

events.title: Opposition bill to end citizenship through property purchase
events.description: CHP MP Mahmut Tanal submits a bill to repeal Art. 12(1)(b) of Citizenship Law 5901 (the basis for investor naturalisation), arguing that foreigners should not obtain citizenship by buying property for small sums; registered as Esas No. 2/4361 and referred to the Interior Committee on 5 April 2022. (The article also covers Turquoise Card holders.)

events.title: Shared-ownership property no longer qualifies
events.description: Per the Land Registry (TKGM) programme page: property shares (hisseli) acquired after 1 Feb 2023 can no longer be used for citizenship, and a shortfall in the investment can no longer be made up with a promise-to-sell contract after that date. The page does not name the instrument that set the rule.

ledger.contains: Consolidated text (29 pages, text layer) of the whole regulation implementing Citizenship Law 5901: definitions, general naturalisation, marriage, adoption, loss, proof, multiple citizenship, Blue Card, etc. In scope only Art. 20: investor routes as currently in force (fixed capital USD 500,000; property or promise-to-sell USD 400,000, built property only; 50 jobs; deposit, government bonds, REIT/venture-capital fund units and private pension USD 500,000 each, all held 3 years, FX sold to the Central Bank), CBRT effective selling and/or cross rate, inter-ministerial commission, switching between routes, certifying bodies set procedures, document list (service fee receipt, no amount); and the table of amending decrees with entry-into-force dates (2016/9601 printed '2016/9061'; 13/6/2022 for the 400,000 change). All these amounts and dates are already in program_terms and events from the Gazette scans (plus two pre-sale terms added in this pass from those scans); no fees, counts or other investment amounts. Rest of the regulation is out of scope.

International Labour Force Law 6735 (Gazette 29800, 13 Aug 2016): work permits, Turquoise Card (3-year transition period), advisory board, fees and penalties for work permits, staff positions list (all out of scope). In scope: Art. 27(9) adding Art. 12(1)(b) to Citizenship Law 5901 (exceptional naturalisation of investor residence permit and Turquoise Card holders and families; already event e-1ef2b8e3a9) and Art. 27(10) adding the investor residence permit (Law 6458 Art. 31(1)(j), amount to be set by the Council of Ministers, permits up to 5 years; event added). No amounts or counts for the programme. In force on publication (Art. 28).

Council of Ministers Decision 2016/9601 (decided 12/12/2016) and the amending regulation (OCR, tur+eng, 2 scanned pages): new Art. 20(2) with five investor routes (USD 2m fixed capital; USD 1m property with 3-year no-sale annotation; 100 jobs; USD 3m bank deposit held 3 years; USD 3m government bonds held 3 years), certifying bodies, new para. 6 (CBRT effective selling rate), in force on publication. All five terms and the launch event are already in the data; nothing further.

Council of Ministers Decision 2017/10008 (decided 13/3/2017) and amending regulation (OCR): new Art. 20(2)(e), USD 1.5m of real-estate or venture-capital investment fund units held 3 years, certified by the Capital Markets Board; in force on publication. Term t-350d8eb806 and event e-5b7c88fb38 already cover it.

Presidential Decision No. 106 (18 Sep 2018) and amending regulation (OCR): thresholds cut (fixed capital, deposit, bonds, fund units USD 500,000; property USD 250,000; 50 jobs; TL or other FX equivalents allowed), deciding authority changed to the President, cross rates added to para. 6, new para. 7 (inter-ministerial commission) and para. 8 (switching between routes). Terms and the price-change event were already in the data; added one rule_change event for the President/commission/cross-rate changes.

Presidential Decision No. 418 (6 Dec 2018) and amending regulation (OCR): adds the notarised promise-to-sell route at USD 250,000 (or FX/TL equivalent) paid upfront with a 3-year non-transfer undertaking; in force on publication. Already term t-848d6c039f and event e-2b6c26a647.

Presidential Decision No. 5072 (5 Jan 2022; Gazette 31711, 6 Jan 2022) and amending regulation (OCR, 2 pages): restates all routes without Turkish lira equivalents (fixed capital, deposit, bonds, fund units USD 500,000 or FX; property and promise-to-sell USD 250,000 or FX; 50 jobs), renames certifying ministries, revises para. 7 (commission), new para. 9 (certifying body sets procedures) and para. 10 (FX sold to a bank and on to the Central Bank; deposit and bonds then held in TL for 3 years). Real-estate term and event were in the data and the other routes' 2018 terms carry the change in their notes; added the pre-sale-contract term for 2022-01-06 to 2022-06-12, which was missing.

Presidential Decision No. 5554 (12 May 2022; Gazette 31834, 13 May 2022) and amending regulation (OCR): '250.000' amounts in Art. 20(2)(b) become '400.000' one month after publication (13 Jun 2022); new route (f) USD 500,000 private pension contribution held 3 years in SEDDK-designated funds; para. 10 extended to (f). Real-estate and pension terms and the event were in the data; added the pre-sale-contract term at USD 400,000 from 2022-06-13.

Presidential Decision No. 7938 (11 Dec 2023; Gazette 32397, 12 Dec 2023) and amending regulation (OCR): property bought under Art. 20(2)(b) must be a unit under condominium/construction servitude or a plot with a building on it; in force on publication. Already term t-95f49947be and event e-b99af7cc7e; no new numbers.

CHP MP Mahmut Tanal's bill of 31 Mar 2022 (5 scanned pages with an uneven text layer; checked by OCR tur+eng): cover letter, TBMM registration stamp (Esas No. 2/4361, Interior Committee, 5 Apr 2022), general reasoning, article reasoning and the 3-article bill repealing Art. 12(1)(b) of Law 5901. Numbers: the USD 1,000,000 and USD 250,000 property thresholds (already terms from the Gazette) and the Environment Ministry figure of 19,630 foreigners obtaining conformity certificates with 30,358 properties from 19 Sep 2018 to 19 Sep 2021 (already rows o-d6c4027806 and o-7debbc3875, status reported). Also mentions the 2014 European Parliament debate (context). Added an event for the bill.

Verbatim record (104 pages) of the Plan and Budget Committee's meeting on the Interior Ministry's 2025 budget: minister's presentation (security operations, migration, disaster management, budget figures) and MPs' speeches and questions, all read for programme content; nearly all out of scope. In scope: minister's cumulative investor-naturalisation figures (p. 99: 159,433 persons, 46,163 investors, 35,399 spouses, 77,871 children; already in the data); İYİ MP Erhan Usta's estimate of about 500,000 people naturalised through investment and about 310,000 house sales to foreigners in seven years (p. 62; added as claims; his 'at least half for citizenship' is words, not recorded as a number); MP Kocamaz's 'TÜİK: 67 thousand dwellings sold to foreigners in 2022' (p. 85; added as claim); MP Murat Çan on a wanted crime-group leader naturalised on 29 Aug 2023 (p. 86; event added). Mentions without new numbers: thresholds of USD 250,000/350-400,000/400,000 cited by MPs (pp. 10, 39, 40, 85), an MP's example of a property worth USD 150,000 valued at 400,000 (p. 44, illustrative), unanswered parliamentary questions on route-by-route counts (pp. 40, 62, 78). Out of scope: 238,781 Syrians naturalised exceptionally (p. 99, not investment), MP Bakırlıoğlu's '800,000 excess voters' (p. 40), foreigner stocks, FDI. MP Aykut Kaya asks (p. 90) for the property amount for a residence permit to be cut from USD 200,000 to 100,000: a residence-by-property rule with no programme in the data (see reply).

Verbatim record (97 pages) of the Plan and Budget Committee's meeting on the Interior Ministry's 2026 budget, read for programme content; nearly all out of scope (security, trustees, migration, disaster, traffic fines). In scope: minister's account (p. 88) of the 24/9/2025 operation in 19 provinces: 117 suspects made sham property sales for 451 foreigners and families, 49 arrested, 24 under judicial control, citizenship of 451 foreigners withdrawn (citizenships_revoked and the event were in the data; added irregular_naturalisations_detected, applicant=main, 451); the minister also says the conformity certificate process belongs to the Land Registry. MPs' statements without numbers: 'golden passport and golden visa' making Turkey a haven for crime leaders (p. 10), questions on valuation-company fraud (p. 25) and unanswered questions on how many were naturalised through investment (p. 77). Out of scope: Syrian exceptional naturalisations (238,697 before 3/6/2023, 2,147 since; p. 86), other Art. 12 routes asked about by MP Meriç (p. 85), red-notice arrest numbers (p. 6).

Land Registry 'Your Key Türkiye' page on the amount certificate (TTB): issued by GEDAŞ from a valuation report via TADEBİS under circular 2024/2 (in force 01/03/2024), sent electronically (paper TTBs not accepted), must be no more than six months old at application; transactions by public bodies, their companies and real-estate investment trusts are exempt unless the Directorate asks. Event e-7dfed7e633 already records the 2024/2 change and six-month validity; no amounts or counts. Images are site icons and logos (not stored).

Land Registry 'Your Key Türkiye' page on citizenship through property: quotes Art. 20(2)(b) (inconsistently: 400,000 'or TL equivalent'); history of the six amendments; thresholds by date of purchase (USD 1,000,000 for 12.01.2017-18.09.2018, 250,000 from 19.09.2018, 400,000 from 13.06.2022; the page also wrongly says 400,000 after 19.09.2018 and 07.12.2018), the same thresholds for property shares; end of the USD 250,000 certificates; 10-step procedure (TTB, FX purchase certificate, title fee and revolving-fund charge with no amount, 3-year no-sale annotation, Property Investment Certificate sent to the Population Directorate and Migration Administration); document list; no limit on the number of properties. Thresholds match the Gazette-based terms already in the data, so no duplicate terms. Added two dated rules: property shares and promise-to-sell top-ups excluded after 01/02/2023, and circular 2024/4 and guide in force 09/12/2024. Process-step images are site graphics (not stored).
